svg.title: Phi2 creditMINT counterexample trace
svg.desc: Swimlane timeline of the 30-state nuXmv counterexample for Phi2. The MICRO credit settles at state 21, micro-deposit confirmed at 22, linked at 23, MICRO debit returned R16 at 30, leaving 1 credit and 0 debits.
svg.text: Φ2 counterexample (A2 creditMINT): 30-state BMC trace from spec-1-INV.log
Originator 1 links Receiver 1’s account by micro-deposit. The MICRO credit settles and the link succeeds, then the recovery MICRO debit is returned R16 (account DEBIT_BLOCKED).
When the verification cycle completes, verification_credits = 1 ≠ verification_debits = 0, so the Φ2 invariant is false. The return window is still open (phase ph_batch_closed).
Source: saved-reference-results/local-run-20261029-artifact-reviews/spec-1-INV.log (check_invar_bmc_inc -n 38 -k 60). Values carried forward between states, as nuXmv prints only changed variables.
